Often found literally pulling the strings from behind the scenes, these Artificers empower their allies rather than risk their life on the front lines.

subclassFeature.name: Arcane Strings
entries: You have learned to craft your signature spool of Arcane Strings which use the rules detailed here:

entries.name: Crafting the Spool
entries: During a long rest, you can spend 1 hour using weaver's tools to craft a spool of Arcane Strings. It is a Tiny spool of thread you can wield as a {@item whip}, you are proficient with it, and it can be a spellcasting focus for Artificer spells.

You can only have one spool of Arcane Strings, and creating a second spool of Strings causes the magic of the previous spool to be instantly dispelled. Only you can wield your Arcane Strings in this way.

entries.name: Infusions
entries: Your Arcane Strings are always infused with the Wondrous Whip Infusion, but this doesn't count against your total number of Infusions Known, and it cannot be replaced.

entries.name: Abilities
entries: While wielding your Arcane Strings, you gain the following special abilities, which can only be used on other willing creatures you can see within 30 feet. When used, your Arcane Strings attach to your target, then return to you:

rows: If a creature misses with a melee attack, you can use your reaction to have it repeat its attack against the same target.
If a creature makes an ability check with a skill you are proficient in, you can add your Intelligence modifier to its roll as a reaction
As a bonus action, you move the attached creature up to half its walking speed. This does not provoke opportunity attacks.

subclassFeature.name: Puppeteer Spells
entries: You learn certain spells at the artificer levels noted in the table below. These don't count against your total number of Spells Known and can't be switched upon gaining a level.

subclassFeature.name: Tools of the Trade
entries: You gain proficiency with weaver's tools and Sleight of Hand. If you are already proficient with weaver's tools, you gain proficiency with another set of artisan's tools.

subclassFeature.name: Skillful Strings
entries: The magic and your skill with your Arcane Strings grows. You gain the following additional Arcane String features:

entries.name: Channel
entries: You cast a spell and have it originate from a target in range. If it requires concentration, you concentrate on it.

entries.name: Pull
entries: When a creature makes a Dexterity saving throw you grant it advantage with your reaction.

entries.name: Strike
entries: When a creature takes the Attack action, you can use a reaction to cause it to make one additional attack as part of its action.

subclassFeature.name: Nimble Fingers
entries: Your ability to manipulate others via your Arcane Strings is truly a marvel. You gain one additional reaction each round, but it can only be used to use an Arcane Strings ability. An effect can only trigger one of your reactions.
Additionally, the range of your Arcane Strings, and all of their abilities, increases to 60 feet.

subclassFeature.name: Master Puppeteer
entries: You are an unquestioned master Puppeteer. Once between each short or long rest, you can use your Arcane Strings to cast the {@spell otto's irresistible dance (alternate)|llspell}, without expending a spell slot, and the target automatically fails its initial saving throw.
Whenever a creature is under the effects of your {@spell otto's irresistible dance (alternate)|llspell} spell, you can use your Arcane Strings Move on it.

subclassFeature.name: Reanimator
entries: Most Artificers focus their creativity on mechanical or arcane inventions, but those known as Reanimators use their unique abilities to raise their defeated enemies as Thralls. Instead of improving themselves, they use necromantic artifice to make use of the abilities of their Thralls had in life, now in undeath.

subclassFeature.name: Reanimated Thrall
entries: You use necromantic artifice to restore a facsimile of life to a slain foe, reanimating it as your Thrall, using the rules here:

entries.name: Reanimating a Thrall
entries: You can use leatherworker's tools to perform a 1-minute ritual on a creature you touch that has died within the last 8 hours. At the end of this ritual, it rises as your Thrall. You can only have one Thrall at a time, and if you raise another Thrall, any previous Thralls die instantly. Once a creature is reanimated as your Thrall, you cannot reanimate that creature as a Thrall again after it dies.

entries.name: Potential Thralls
entries: Your artifice only allows you to raise Beasts, Humanoids, and Monstrosities as your Thralls, and the strength of the creatures you can raise is limited by their Challenge Rating. You can raise one of the above creatures as your Thrall if the creature's Challenge Rating is equal to your Artificer level divided by three, rounded down.

entries.name: Thrall Statistics
entries: Your Thrall is mindless and follows you with absolute loyalty. It uses the stat block it had in life, but it gains the Undead creature type in addition to its type, it has no Hit Dice, and it gains no benefits from short or long rests. When you reanimate a creature as your Thrall, it is restored to full health and abilities as if it completed a long rest.

entries.name: Combat
entries: In combat, your Thrall acts on your turn. It can move and use its reaction on its own, but it will only take the Dodge action on its turn unless you use your bonus action to command it to take one of the actions from its stat block or another action. If you are incapacitated, your Thrall will act to defend you, but it will take no further actions.
If your Thrall has the ability to cast spells, you must expend one of your spell slots when you order it to cast one of its spells.

subclassFeature.name: Reanimator Spells
entries: You learn certain spells at the artificer levels noted in the table below. These don't count against your total number of Spells Known and can't be switched upon gaining a level.

subclassFeature.name: Tools of the Trade
entries: You gain proficiency in Nature and leatherworker's tools. If you are already proficient in leatherworker's tools, you gain proficiency with a set of artisan's tools of your choice.

subclassFeature.name: Extra Attack
entries: You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn. Moreover, you can forgo one of these attacks to order your Thrall to make a single attack.

subclassFeature.name: Necrotic Preservation
entries: You can preserve the dead for later use. When you cast {@spell gentle repose} on a creature that you could raise as a Thrall, you can transform it into a small Trinket, which lasts for the duration.
At any point, you can use your Reanimated Thrall ritual on one of these Trinkets to raise that creature within as a Thrall.

subclassFeature.name: Advanced Reanimations
entries: You can raise some of the most powerful mortal creatures to serve you as Thralls. You can raise Aberrations, Dragons, and Giants as your Thralls, so long as the creatures are within the Challenge Rating limited detailed in Reanimated Thrall.

subclassFeature.name: Master Reanimator
entries: You can keep your Thralls alive so long as your power lasts. If your Thrall is reduced to 0 hit points but isn't killed outright, you can use your reaction to expend a spell slot. The Thrall is instead reduced to a number of hit points equal to 10 times the level of the spell slot.
This feature cannot cause your Thrall to exceed its hit point maximum.

subclassFeature.name: Cartographer
entries: Your signature artifice has been honed for use in adventuring. With your wondrous Arcane Atlas in hand you delve deep into ancient dungeons and elder temples in pursuit of lost secrets which lie hidden. Adventure calls. Will your artifice answer?

subclassFeature.name: Arcane Arts
entries: You have honed your artifice for exploration applications. You can produce an Arcane Atlas, which uses the following rules:

entries.name: Crafting your Atlas
entries: During a long rest, you can spend 1 hour using Calligrapher's Supplies to create an Arcane Atlas. It takes the form of a Tiny book, map, scroll, or another object that can be used to record maps. You can only have one such Atlas, and crafting another destroys any previous Atlases.

entries.name: Arcane Insights
entries: While holding your Atlas, a perfect map of your surroundings out to a 30-foot radius appears for you to view. This map does not reveal creatures, objects, or other structures (like traps and doors) hidden by magic. Your Atlas updates as you move with it, but does not create a permanent map of places you have been unless you create another copy.

entries.name: Cartographer's Magic
entries: While holding your Atlas, it can be used as a Spellcasting Focus for Artificer spells. Additionally, you can target any creature, object, or point which appears on your Atlas with an Artificer spell, even if your spell otherwise would require you to see or touch the target.

entries.name: Infusions
entries: The Atlas can bear any one Infusion meant for a Spellcasting Focus, diadem, helm, ring, or necklace.

entries.name: Improvements
entries: As you gain Artificer levels, the radius that your Atlas reveals increases: at 5th level (60 feet), 10th level (120 feet), and finally at 15th level (300 feet).

subclassFeature.name: Cartographer Spells
entries: You learn certain spells at the artificer levels noted in the table below. These don't count against your total number of Spells Known and can't be switched upon gaining a level.

subclassFeature.name: Tools of the Trade
entries: You gain proficiency with Cartographer's and Calligrapher's Tools. If you are already proficient in either Tool, you instead gain proficiency in a set of Artisan's Tools of your choice.

subclassFeature.name: Arcane Accuracy
entries: The wondrous magic of your Atlas aids your aim. So long as you are wielding your Atlas you cannot have disadvantage on attack rolls against targets which appear on your Atlas. When you damage such a target with an Artificer spell, you add your Intelligence modifier (minimum of +1) to the damage roll.

subclassFeature.name: Chart a Course
entries: Your knowledge of positioning allows you to move creatures about as you explore. While wielding your Atlas, you can use a bonus action to cause two willing creatures which appear on your Atlas to switch places.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all uses when you complete a long rest.

subclassFeature.name: Wondrous Cartography
entries: As an action, you can expend a spell slot to infuse your Atlas with additional power for 1 minute. You must concentrate on this effect, and for the duration, your Atlas reveals creatures, objects, and structures as if it had Truesight.

subclassFeature.name: Master Cartographer
entries: You have mastered your signature artifice. While Wondrous Cartography is active, you can use Chart a Course on each of your turns without expending a use.

Finally, once per long rest, you can cast the find the path spell without expending a spell slot so long as you use your Arcane Atlas as the Spellcasting Focus. When you do, a map to the point appears on your Atlas, but your Atlas cannot be used for anything else while the spell is active.

optionalfeature.name: Adjustable Tool Set

item: a set of artisan's tools (requires attunement)

entries: The wielder is considered proficient with this magical set of Tools. As an action, they can transform this set of Tools into another set of Artisan's Tools of their choice.

entries.name: Improvement
entries: At 11th level, this set of Tools grants a +1 bonus to ability checks. This becomes +2 at 17th level.

optionalfeature.name: Agent Model
entries: As an action, you perceive the world through the Automaton senses, but become Blinded and Deafened to your own senses. While doing so, you can control the Automaton directly, using its actions and moving. It can also take the Hide action.
This effect ends if you use your bonus action to end it. It also ends if your Automaton is more than 1 mile from you.

optionalfeature.name: Amphibian Model
entries: The Automaton gains a 30-foot swimming speed, Darkvision out to a range of 120-feet while it is underwater, and while it is swimming, it has advantage on its Slam attack rolls.

optionalfeature.name: Amphibian Physiology
entries: Your neck sprouts gills or your skin becomes permeable like an amphibious creature. You gain a swimming speed equal to your walking speed, and you can breathe both air and water.

optionalfeature.name: Anchor Model
entries: As an action, the Automaton latches onto a target within 5 feet, reducing the target's speed by a number of feet equal to 5 times your Intelligence modifier (minimum of 5 feet). The Automaton cannot take actions or move while attached, but it can still be targeted by attacks and effects.
As an action, a creature can make a Strength check against your Spell save DC, removing the Automaton on a success.

optionalfeature.name: Arachnid Model
entries: The Automaton gains a 30-foot climbing speed, and it can climb on difficult surfaces, including sheer walls and upside down on ceilings, without making an ability check.

optionalfeature.name: Arachnoid Grip
entries: Your hands and feet secrete a sticky substance. You gain a climbing speed equal to your walking speed, you can climb difficult surfaces without needing to make an ability check.
Also, creatures have disadvantage on ability checks or saving throws they make to escape being grappled by you.

optionalfeature.name: Arcane Model
entries: When you cast an Artificer spell, you can choose for the spell to originate from this Automaton, instead of yourself, so long as you are within 60 feet of the Automaton.
This Automaton's Slam attack also deals force damage.

optionalfeature.name: Arcane Railgun
entries: Once on your turn, you can forgo an Arcane Firearm attack to instead unleash a directed pulse of arcane energies from your Arcane Firearm, forcing targets in a 60-foot line to make a Dexterity saving throw. Creatures take 4d6 Force damage on a failure, and half as much Force damage on a success.

optionalfeature.name: Archer Model
entries: When this Automaton makes a Slam attack, it can choose to make it a ranged weapon attack against a target that it can see within 60 feet. On hit, it deals piercing damage.

optionalfeature.name: Arm Launcher
entries: As an action, this magical launcher can be loaded with up to five Tiny objects, such as individual bags of ball bearings or caltrops, or vials of acid, alchemist's fire, oil, or holy water.
As a bonus action, the wearer can activate the launcher to fire one of the objects loaded in it, making a ranged weapon attack against a target or space it can see within 20 feet.

optionalfeature.name: Armor Model
entries: As an action, the Automaton attaches itself to one willing creature within 5 feet, granting it a bonus to Armor Class equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of +1). The Automaton can still be targeted by attacks while attached.
The Automaton can detach from the target as an action.

optionalfeature.name: Armor of Strength
entries: This magical armor grants its wearer a +1 bonus to its Armor Class, and it adds your Intelligence modifier (minimum of +1) to all Strength ability checks and saving throws.

entries.name: Improvement
entries: At 17th level, this magical armor grants its wearer a +2 bonus to its Armor Class.

optionalfeature.name: Artificial Limb
entries: This magic prosthetic limb attaches to a creature, seamlessly covering one limb or replacing a lost limb. As a bonus action, the wearer can extend, or retract the limb up to 10 feet.

optionalfeature.name: Artisan Model
entries: The Automaton is proficient with one set of tools, which you choose upon its creation. As an action, it can use the tools to make an ability check and add your Intelligence modifier (a minimum of +1) to the result of its ability check.

optionalfeature.name: Assault Model
entries: This Automaton is fortified for combat. It becomes Small in size, it gains additional hit points equal to your Artificer level, and its Slam attack deals 1d10 Force damage on hit, instead of the normal Bludgeoning damage.A

optionalfeature.name: Astral Cannon

item: gauntlet, arcane focus, or metal rod

entries: In place of an attack, the wielder of this magical object can make a ranged spell attack against a target it can see within 60 feet. On hit, the target takes 2d10 force damage.

As an action, the wielder can expend one Charge to fire two dimensional motes at two unoccupied flat surfaces that it can see within 60 feet, creating one 5-foot by 5-foot portal that connects the two surfaces. This portal remains open for 1 minute, but it is closed early if five creatures pass through it, or if this Infusion is used to create another portal.

entries.name: Charges
entries: This item has Charges equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of 1). It regains all Charges at each dawn.

optionalfeature.name: Avenger Model
entries: When a creature within 25 feet of the Automaton attacks or forces another creature to make a saving throw, you can use a reaction to order this Automaton to move up to its walking speed and make a Slam attack against that creature. On hit, this attack deals a bonus 1d6 bludgeoning damage.

optionalfeature.name: Avian Flight
entries: A pair of feathered or leathery wings sprout forth from your back. You gain a flying speed equal to your walking speed.

optionalfeature.name: Avian Model
entries: The Automaton gains a 30-foot flying speed, and while flying, opportunity attacks against this Automaton are made with disadvantage.

optionalfeature.name: Belt of Utility

item: belt or vest with ten pockets

entries: This magical belt has ten Tiny pockets which can each hold a Tiny or smaller object. As an action, bonus action, or as part of an attack, the wearer can call to mind one object in one of the pockets, instantly summoning it into its hand and can use it as part of that action, bonus action, or attack.
If the wearer does not have a free hand when it summons the object, it shunts one object it is holding into that pouch.

optionalfeature.name: Bestial Senses
entries: Your eyes and ears resemble those of predators. Whenever you make a Wisdom-based ability check based on your sense of hearing, sight, or smell, you add your Intelligence modifier (minimum of +1) to your roll.

optionalfeature.name: Blinding Round
entries: When you hit a creature with an Arcane Firearm attack, you can use a bonus action to cause the round to emit a flash of light, forcing that target to make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, it is Blinded until the start of your next turn.

optionalfeature.name: Boots of Destruction
entries: The wearer of these magical boots cannot be knocked prone or moved against its will. It also knows {@spell destructive wave}, and can cast destructive wave once without expending a spell slot.
The wearer of these magic boots regains the ability to cast the spell without expending a spell slot at the following dawn.

optionalfeature.name: Chameleon Armor
entries: This magical armor grants its wearer a +1 bonus to its Armor Class. The wearer can use an action to expend Charges and cast one of the spells here on itself: disguise self (1 Charge), invisibility (2 Charges) or greater invisibility (4 Charges).

entries.name: Charges
entries: This item has Charges equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of 1). It regains all Charges at each dawn.

entries.name: Improvement
entries: At 17th level, this magical armor grants its wearer a +2 bonus to its Armor Class.

optionalfeature.name: Spread Shot
entries: In place of a normal Arcane Firearm attack, you can unleash a spray of energy, forcing targets in an adjacent 10-foot cone to make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, they take 2d6 Force damage.

optionalfeature.name: Collar of Taming
entries: When worn by a beast with a CR equal to or less than your Intelligence modifier, this magical collar allows the creature attuned to exert absolute control over that beast.

The collared beast is friendly to you and obeys your orders completely. In combat you share initiative and it acts during your turn. It can move and use its reaction on its own, but it only takes the Dodge action unless you use a bonus action to order it to take an action from its stat block or another action. If you can ride the beast then it counts as a trained mount.

entries.name: Improvement
entries: At 17th level, this magical collar can be used to control both Beasts and Mostrosities.

optionalfeature.name: Concussive Round
entries: When you hit a creature with an Arcane Firearm attack, you can use a bonus action to cause the round to emit a burst of concussive force, forcing that target to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it can't take reactions and its speed is halved until the start of your next turn.

optionalfeature.name: Create Advanced Elixir
entries: Each time you select this Infusion, choose one Elixir effect to learn from the table. To produce an additional advanced elixir, you must expend a spell slot of 3rd-level or higher.

optionalfeature.name: Create Expert Elixir
entries: Each time you select this Infusion, choose one Elixir effect to learn from the table. To produce an additional expert elixir, you must expend a spell slot of 4th-level or higher.

optionalfeature.name: Create Greater Elixir
entries: Each time you select this Infusion, choose one Elixir effect to learn from the table. To produce an additional greater elixir, you must expend a spell slot of 2nd-level or higher.

optionalfeature.name: Create Masterwork Elixir
entries: Each time you select this Infusion, choose one Elixir effect to learn from the table. To produce an additional masterwork elixir, you must expend a spell slot of 5th-level or higher.

optionalfeature.name: Create Minor Elixir
entries: Each time you select this Infusion, choose two Elixir effects to learn from the table. To produce an additional minor elixir, you must expend a spell slot of 1st-level or higher.

optionalfeature.name: Deadly Accuracy
entries: When you make a weapon attack with your Arcane Firearm, or use it as a Spellcasting Focus to cast a spell with a Spell Attack Roll, you ignore the effects of half cover, and can treat three-quarter's cover as half cover.

optionalfeature.name: Elemental Armor
entries: This magical armor grants its wearer a +1 bonus to its Armor Class, and its wearer is resistant to your choice of either acid, cold, fire, lightning, necrotic, poison, radiant, or thunder.

entries.name: Improvement
entries: At 17th level, this armor grants its wearer a +2 bonus to its Armor Class and two damage Resistances.

optionalfeature.name: Elemental Prism

item: diamond worth at least 50 gold and an arcane focus

entries: This magical diamond is bonded to an arcane focus. When the wielder of this focus casts a spell that deals damage, it can change the spell's damage to acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison, or thunder damage.

entries.name: Improvement
entries: At 17th level, this item grants its wielder a +1 bonus to both its spell attack rolls and its Spell save DC.

optionalfeature.name: Elemental Ring
entries: When the wearer of this magic ring casts a spell of 3rd-level or lower that deals Acid, Cold, Fire, or Lightning damage, it can deal maximum damage to one target. Once the wearer uses this ring to maximize the damage of a spell it cannot be used again until the next dawn.

entries.name: Improvement
entries: At 17th level, this magic ring can maximize the damage for any spell of 5th-level or lower for one target.

optionalfeature.name: Elemental Infusion
entries: As a bonus action, you touch your Arcane Firearm, expend a spell slot of 1st-level or higher, and infuse it with Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Poison. For 1 minute, its attacks deal that type of damage, plus a bonus 1d4 damage of that type.
This bonus damage is 1d4 for a 1st-level spell slot, plus an additional 1d4 for each spell slot level above 1st.

optionalfeature.name: Elemental Weapon
entries: You infuse a melee weapon with elemental power, choosing acid, cold, fire, poison, or lightning, and a command word.

The wielder of this magic weapon can speak its command word to cause elemental power to wreathe the weapon until it speaks the command word again. For the duration, it deals a bonus 1d6 damage of the type you chose on hit.

entries.name: Improvement
entries: At 17th level, bonus damage becomes 2d6.

optionalfeature.name: Enhanced Arcane Focus
entries: This magic item grants its wielder +1 bonus to spell attack rolls, and it ignores half cover when making spell attacks.

entries.name: Improvement
entries: This magic item's bonus to spell attack rolls increases at 11th level (+2) and 17th level (+3).

optionalfeature.name: Enhanced Defense

item: suit of armor or a shield

entries: This magical item grants its wearer or wielder a +1 bonus to its Armor Class while wearing or wielding this infused item.

entries.name: Improvement
entries: This magical item's bonus to Armor Class increases at 11th level (+2) and 17th level (+3).

optionalfeature.name: Enhanced Instrument
entries: The wielder is proficient with this magical instrument and can use it as a spellcasting focus for its spells. Whenever it makes an ability check using the instrument, it can add your Intelligence modifier (minimum of +1) to its roll.
At 11th level, this magical instrument grants its wielder a +1 bonus to its Spell save DC when used as a spellcasting focus. This bonus increases to +2 at 17th level.

entries.name: Improvement
entries: At 11th level, this Instrument grants a +1 bonus to Spell save DC. This becomes +2 at 17th level.

optionalfeature.name: Enhanced Physicality
entries: Your muscles and veins engorge with arcane power. When you make a Strength ability check or saving throw you can add your Intelligence modifier (minimum of +1) to your roll.
You also count as one size larger for the purposes of your Grapple and Shove attempts.

optionalfeature.name: Enhanced Weapon
entries: This magic weapon grants its wielder a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls it makes with this infused weapon.

entries.name: Improvement
entries: This magical item's bonus to damage and attack rolls increases at 11th level (+2) and 17th level (+3).

optionalfeature.name: Explosive Round
entries: When you hit a creature with an Arcane Firearm attack, you can use a bonus action to cause the round to explode, forcing other creatures within 5 feet of the target to make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, they take Fire damage equal to the damage dealt by one of your Arcane Firearm attacks.

optionalfeature.name: Featherweight Belt
entries: This magical belt reduces the weight of its wearer and any objects it carries to one-tenth, without decreasing its abilities.

entries.name: Improvement
entries: At 11th level, this magical item reduces the weight of its wearer and objects it carries to one-hundredth.

optionalfeature.name: Featherweight Weapon

item: simple or martial melee weapon (requires attunement)

entries: This magic weapon no longer has the heavy and two-handed properties if it had it. If it does not have either the heavy or two-handed property, it instead gains the light property.

entries.name: Improvement
entries: At 11th level, this weapon gains a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls. This becomes +2 at 17th level.

optionalfeature.name: Gem of Warding

item: gem worth at least 100 gold to serve as its core

entries: As an action, the wielder of this magical gem can expend one of its Charges and throw it to an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet, where it hovers 5 feet above the ground for 1 minute, or until destroyed. It then returns to its wielder.

entries.name: Statistics
entries: This magical gem has hit points equal to your Artificer level and its Armor Class equals your Spell save DC.

entries.name: Activation
entries: The wielder can use a bonus action to move the gem up to 20 feet, or to emit a pulse, granting creatures of the wielder's choice within 10 feet of the gem temporary hit points equal to your Intelligence modifier.

entries.name: Charges
entries: This item has Charges equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of 1). It regains all Charges at dawn.

optionalfeature.name: Goggles of Clearsight

item: helm, pair of goggles, or glasses

entries: While wearing these magic goggles, the wearer ignores light and heavy obscurement caused by both natural and magical phenomena, including darkness. The wearer can also ignore the negative effects of the Sunlight Sensitivity trait.

entries.name: Improvement
entries: At 11th level, these magic goggles grant the wearer Immunity to the Blinded condition.

optionalfeature.name: Greater Arcane Item

item: Tiny object, tool, or arcane focus (requires attunement)

entries: You imbue this object with a greater amount of arcane power, choosing a 2nd-level Artificer spell you know to infuse within. Any creature that holds this item can expend one Charge to cast the imbued spell at 2nd-level, using your Infused Magic Spellcasting. If the spell requires concentration, the caster must concentrate on the spell for the duration.

entries.name: Improvement
entries: This item has Charges equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of 1). It regains all Charges at each dawn.

optionalfeature.name: Greater Physique
entries: Magic forcefully enlarges your body, giving you hideous size. You grow by one size (for example, from Medium to Large), your reach increases by 5 feet, your weight is multiplied by eight, and melee weapon attacks deal a bonus 1d4 damage.

optionalfeature.name: Grooved Barrel
entries: You modify your Arcane Firearm to be especially accurate. You ignore the disadvantage imposed both when attacking a target within your Arcane Firearm's long range, and when making a ranged attack at a target within 5 feet of you.

optionalfeature.name: Guardian Gauntlets
entries: When a creature ends its turn within 30 feet of the wearer of these magic gauntlets, the wearer can use its reaction to expend one Charge, forcing the creature to make a Strength saving throw. Any creature larger than the wearer has advantage. On a failure, the creature is pulled up to 30 feet toward the wearer, stopping in unoccupied space of their choice. If it stops within 5 feet of the wearer, the wearer can make a melee weapon attack against it, or choose to Grapple the creature if it is of a size the wearer could Grapple.

entries.name: Charges
entries: This item has Charges equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of 1). It regains all Charges at each dawn.

optionalfeature.name: Helm of Awareness
entries: The wearer of this magic helm cannot be surprised unless it is incapacitated. It also adds your Intelligence modifier (minimum of +1) to its initiative rolls.

optionalfeature.name: Hideous Regeneration
entries: If you begin your turn with less than half of your hit points remaining, but at least 1 hit point, you instantly regain hit points equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of 1).

optionalfeature.name: High Caliber
entries: You increase the firepower of the Arcane Firearm. Its range increases to (100/400), its damage die increases from 1d10 to 2d6, and it gains the heavy and two-handed properties.

optionalfeature.name: Homing Weapon

item: weapon with the ranged or thrown property

entries: The wielder of this magic weapon ignores the disadvantage imposed when attacking at the weapon's long range.

entries.name: Improvement
entries: At 11th level, this weapon gains a +1 bonus to its spell attack rolls. This becomes +2 at 17th level.

optionalfeature.name: Homunculus Servant

item: gem worth at least 100 gold to serve as its core

entries: Experiments have yielded you a loyal {@creature Homunculus Servant|LLAART|Homunculus Servant}. You choose its appearance, but it has no effect on its abilities. It is Friendly, and obeys your orders. It uses the Homunculus Servant stat block, which uses your Proficiency Bonus (PB).

entries.name: Creating the Homunculus
entries: During a long rest, you can spend 1 hour using tinker's tools to create a Homunculus. You can only have one Homunculus. If you create another the previous turns to ash. If your Homunculus dies, you expend a spell slot and spend 1 minute repairing it with your tinker's tools, restoring it to life with its maximum hit points. If you die, your Homunculus turns to ash after 1 minute.

entries.name: Combat
entries: In combat, your Homunculus acts during your turn. It can move and use its reaction on its own, but it only takes the Dodge action on its turn unless you use your bonus action to order it to take an action in its stat block, or another action. If you are incapacitated, your Homunculus can act on its own and will defend its master to the best of its abilities.

optionalfeature.name: Immovable Boots
entries: If the wearer is standing on a flat surface, it can use an action to activate the boots, fixing itself in place with magic. Until it uses an action to deactivate the boots, they do not move, even if they are defying gravity. To move the boots and their wearer, a creature must succeed on a DC 30 Strength check.

optionalfeature.name: Incapacitating Round
entries: When you hit a creature with an Arcane Firearm attack, you can use a bonus action to cause the round to erupt with great force, forcing that creature to make a Strength saving throw. Large and larger creatures have advantage on their roll. On a failure, it is Incapacitated until the start of your next turn, or until it takes damage or is forced to make a saving throw.

optionalfeature.name: Independent Turret
entries: As an action, you can set your Arcane Firearm up as a turret in an unoccupied 5-foot space. While you are within 120 feet of your Arcane Firearm, you can use a bonus action to cause your Arcane Firearm to make an attack, or use another one of its abilities, targeting a creature you can see in its range.

optionalfeature.name: Infiltrator Armor
entries: This magic suit of armor retains its weight but is formfitting and wearable under clothes without detection. It also grants its wearer advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.

entries.name: Improvement
entries: At 11th level, this armor grants its wearer a +1 bonus to its Armor Class. This becomes +2 at 17th level.

optionalfeature.name: Levitating Weapon
entries: Upon Infusion, you choose a command word for this weapon. As a bonus action, the wielder can speak the magic weapon's command word, expending one of its Charges. When it does so, the weapon begins to hover in its space, and attacks one target of its choice within 5 feet, using your Intelligence, in place of the wielder's Strength or Dexterity, for its attack and damage rolls. While this magic weapon hovers, the wielder can attack with it using its bonus action on each turn.
This magical weapon remains active for 1 minute, or until the wielder speaks its command word again, at which point it returns to its wielder's empty hand, sheath, or belt.

entries.name: Charges
entries: This item has Charges equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of 1). It regains all Charges at each dawn.

optionalfeature.name: Light Blade

item: sword hilt or arcane focus (requires attunement)

entries: While it is grasping this magical object, the wielder can use a bonus action to cause a blade of pure radiance to spring into existence, or disappear. It has the following properties:

entries.name: Statistic
entries: The blade is a simple melee weapon with the Finesse property, and it deals 1d8 Radiant damage on hit. It emits bright light out to a 15-foot radius and dim light out to a 15-foot radius beyond that.

entries.name: Radiant Burst
entries: When the wielder hits a creature with this weapon, it can expend one Charge to force the target to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is Blinded until the start of the wielder's next turn.

entries.name: Charges
entries: This item has Charges equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of 1). It regains all Charges at each dawn.

entries.name: Improvement
entries: At 11th level, this weapon gains a +1 bonus to its spell attack rolls. This becomes +2 at 17th level.

optionalfeature.name: Lightning Cannon

item: gauntlet, arcane focus, or metal rod

entries: The wielder can forgo any attack to instead use this magical object to make a ranged spell attack against one target it can see within 60 feet, using your Artificer Spell Attack modifier. On hit, the target takes 2d6 Lightning damage.

entries.name: Improvement
entries: At 11th level, this weapon gains a +1 bonus to its spell attack rolls. This becomes +2 at 17th level.

optionalfeature.name: Many-Handed Pouch

item: individual pouches equal to your Intelligence modifier

entries: These magic pouches all share one interdimensional space with the capacity of a single pouch. Reaching into an infused pouch allows access to this shared storage space. A pouch operates as long as it is within 100 miles of another pouch; the pouch is otherwise empty and won't accept contents.
If the Infusion ends, the items stored in the shared space all move into one of the pouches, determined at random.

optionalfeature.name: Masterwork Arcane Item

item: Tiny object, tool, or arcane focus (requires attunement)

entries: You imbue this object with your extraordinary arcane power, choosing a 3rd-level Artificer spell you know to infuse within. Any creature that holds this item can expend one Charge to cast the imbued spell with your Artificer spellcasting ability.
If the imbued spell requires concentration, the wielder of the item must concentrate on the spell for the duration.

entries.name: Charges
entries: This item has Charges equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of 1). It regains all Charges at each dawn.

optionalfeature.name: Masterwork Homunculus
entries: You have discovered the secrets to the creation of life. You learn the {@spell clone} spell. It counts as an Artificer spell for you, but it doesn't count against your total number of Spells Known. You can cast clone without expending a spell slot as long as you have the material components available. Your clone only takes 12 days to reach maturity, but you can only have one.
If you replace this Infusion with another at any point before your clone reaches maturity, the spell immediately fails.

optionalfeature.name: Metamorphosis Armor
entries: As a bonus action, the wearer of this magical suit of armor can expend a Charge to cast enlarge/reduce, targeting itself, without expending a spell slot or requiring concentration.

entries.name: Charges
entries: This item has Charges equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of 1). It regains all Charges at each dawn.

entries.name: Improvement
entries: At 17th level, the wearer can expend two Charges at once to reduce or grow its size by two categories

optionalfeature.name: Mind Sharpener

item: helmet, diadem, suit of armor, or robes

entries: When the wearer of this magical object fails a Constitution saving throw to maintain concentration, it can use a reaction to expend a Charge from this object to succeed instead.

entries.name: Charges
entries: This item has Charges equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of 1). It regains all Charges at each dawn.

optionalfeature.name: Mind Shield
entries: The wearer of this magic helm gains resistance to psychic damage, immunity to the charmed and frightened conditions, magic that would read its thoughts or dreams, and it cannot be targeted by telepathy unless it wishes to.

optionalfeature.name: Minor Arcane Item

item: Tiny object, tool, or arcane focus (requires attunement)

entries: You imbue this object with a minor amount of arcane power, choosing a 1st-level Artificer spell you know to infuse within. Any creature that holds this item can expend one Charge to cast the imbued spell at 1st-level, using your Infused Magic Spellcasting. If the spell requires concentration, the caster must concentrate on the spell for the duration.

entries.name: Charges
entries: This item has Charges equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of 1). It regains all Charges at each dawn.

optionalfeature.name: Monstrous Claw
entries: You transform one of your limbs into a monstrous arm ending in a massive pincer. Your unarmed strikes with this claw deal slashing damage equal to 1d8 + your Strength modifier, and on hit, you can choose to automatically grapple your target if it is equal to your size or smaller.

optionalfeature.name: Mystic Armament
entries: All damage dealt by this magic weapon is Force damage, and its attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 18-20 on the d20. The wielder knows the steel wind strike ll spell, and can cast the spell once without expending a spell slot using this weapon.
The wielder of this magic weapon regains the ability to cast the spell without expending a spell slot at the following dawn.

optionalfeature.name: Mystic Shot
entries: All damage dealt by this magic weapon is Force damage, and its attacks ignore half cover and treat three-quarters cover as half cover. The wielder knows the {@spell swift quiver (alternate)|llspell}, and can cast it once without expending a spell slot using this weapon.
The wielder of this magic weapon regains the ability to cast the spell without expending a spell slot at the following dawn.

optionalfeature.name: Power Whip
entries: The damage die of this magic whip becomes a d10, and once per turn when the wielder hits a Large or smaller target with a Power Whip attack, they can force it to make a Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone.

entries.name: Improvement
entries: At 11th level, this weapon gains a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls. This becomes +2 at 17th level.

optionalfeature.name: Repeating Shot
entries: This magic weapon ignores the loading property if it has it. If you load no ammunition into the weapon it produces its own, creating magic ammunition when you make a ranged attack. The ammunition vanishes after it either hits or misses.

entries.name: Improvement
entries: At 11th level, this weapon gains a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls. This becomes +2 at 17th level.

optionalfeature.name: Replaceable Parts
entries: Your Arcane Firearm is crafted to be adjusted on the fly. Over the course of 10 minutes, which can be during a short or long rest, you can use Smith's Tools to completely redesign your Arcane Firearm, replacing any number of its Upgrages.

optionalfeature.name: Repulsion Gauntlets

item: pair of gloves or gauntlets (requires attunement)

entries: While wearing these magical gauntlets, the unarmed strikes of the wearer deal 1d8 Thunder damage. On hit, their wearer can expend a Charge to force their target to make a Strength saving throw. Targets larger than the wearer have advantage on this saving throw. On a failure, the target is knocked back in a line a number of feet equal to 5 times your Intelligence modifier (a minimum of 5 feet).

entries.name: Charges
entries: This item has Charges equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of 1). It regains all Charges at each dawn.

entries.name: Improvement
entries: At 11th level, this weapon gains a +1 bonus to its spell attack rolls. This becomes +2 at 17th level.

optionalfeature.name: Repulsion Shield
entries: When the wielder of this shield is hit by a melee attack, it expend a Charge as a reaction, forcing its attacker to make a Strength saving throw. Attackers larger than the wielder have advantage. On a failed save, it is knocked back feet equal to 5 times your Intelligence modifier (minimum of 5 feet).

entries.name: Charges
entries: This item has Charges equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of 1). It regains all Charges at each dawn.

entries.name: Improvement
entries: At 11th level, this shield grants its bearer a +1 bonus to its Armor Class. This becomes +2 at 17th level.

optionalfeature.name: Resilient Hide
entries: Your flesh grows hideously thick. When not wearing armor, your Armor Class equals 10 + your Intelligence modifier + your Constitution modifier.

optionalfeature.name: Returning Weapon
entries: This magical weapon immediately flies back to the hand of its wielder after they make a thrown weapon attack with it.

entries.name: Improvement
entries: At 11th level, this weapon gains a +1 bonus to its spell attack rolls. This becomes +2 at 17th level.

optionalfeature.name: Ring of Knowledge
entries: Upon Infusion, choose one skill, tool, or weapon that you are proficient with, or one language that you can speak, read, and write. The wearer of this magic ring is considered proficient in that chosen skill, tool, or weapon, or knows that language.

optionalfeature.name: Ring of Potential
entries: While wearing this magical ring, the wearer can use a bonus action to expend its Charges and regain one expended spell slot equal to the number of Charges expended.

entries.name: Charges
entries: This magic ring has three Charges, and it regains all of its expended Charges each day at dawn.

optionalfeature.name: Skittering Servant
entries: You have built a Skittering Servant, a Tiny Construct with multiple legs. It has hit points equal to your Artificer level and its Armor Class is equal to your Spell save DC. As an action, you can use Tinker's Tools to attach (or remove) one weapon or object to the Servant. It can only have one attached.

As an action, you can expend one of the Servant's Charges and throw it to an unoccupied space you can see within 30 ft. where it activates. It is active for 1 minute or until destroyed, then it deactivates, instantly returning to its wielder.

While activated, you can use your bonus action to order the Servant to move up to 20 feet and use the object attached to it as if you were using it. The Servant can move up walls and difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without having to make an ability check.

entries.name: Charges
entries: This item has Charges equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of 1). It regains all Charges at each dawn.

optionalfeature.name: Skyfall Harness
entries: This magic harness has wing-like fins between its limbs that slow falls and allow its wearer to glide. When the wearer falls and isn't incapacitated, it subtracts up to 100 feet from its fall when calculating falling damage, and when it falls at least 10 feet, it can glide 2 feet horizontally every 1 foot that it falls.

optionalfeature.name: Thought Blade
entries: This magical weapon translates the wielder's thoughts into physical movements, allowing it to wield it with its mind. It can use its Intelligence, in place of its Strength or Dexterity, for this magical weapon's attack and damage rolls.

entries.name: Improvement
entries: At 11th level, this weapon gains a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls. This becomes +2 at 17th level.

optionalfeature.name: Vampiric Weapon
entries: When the wielder hits a creature with this weapon, it deals a bonus 1d6 Necrotic damage on hit, and the wielder can gain temporary hit points equal to that Necrotic damage. This weapon has no effect against undead or constructs.

entries.name: Improvement
entries: At 17th level, the bonus Necrotic damage dealt on hit increases to 2d6.

optionalfeature.name: Vestigial Limb
entries: You grow an additional grotesque limb that resembles your other limbs in a place of your choice. It can perform any task your limbs can including the ability to use weapons, shields, magic items, tools, and other objects.

optionalfeature.name: Voyager Boots
entries: The wearer of these magical boots can use a bonus action to teleport up to 15 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

entries.name: Improvement
entries: At 17th level, these boots can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space when they are used.

optionalfeature.name: Wall Shield
entries: As an action, the wielder can slam this magic shield into the ground, expending Charges to produce the effects of wall of stone centered on the shield, which remains in the ground. However, this effect only creates a number of panels equal to the Charges spent, it doesn't require concentration, and lasts for 1 minute. The wall is destroyed if the shield is removed.

entries.name: Charges
entries: This item has Charges equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of 1). It regains all Charges at each dawn.

entries.name: Improvement
entries: At 11th level, this shield grants its bearer a +1 bonus to its Armor Class. This becomes +2 at 17th level.

optionalfeature.name: War Gauntlet

item: armored gauntlet and a martial weapon or shield

entries: You attach a shield or martial weapon that can be wielded one-handed, or a shield, to this magical gauntlet. The wearer is proficient with the attached item, and the wearer cannot be disarmed of this item.

entries.name: Improvement
entries: At 11th level, this gauntlet grants its wearer a +1 bonus to its Armor Class. This becomes +2 at 17th level.

optionalfeature.name: Wildfire Cannon

item: gauntlet, arcane focus, or metal rod

entries: As an action, the wielder of this magical object can expend Charges and use your Artificer Spellcasting modifier to cast these spells: {@spell firebolt} (0 Charges), {@spell burning hands} (1 Charge), {@spell scorching ray} (2 Charges), or {@spell fireball} (3 Charges).

entries.name: Charges
entries: This item has Charges equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of 1). It regains all of its Charges each day at dawn.

optionalfeature.name: Winged Glide
entries: You grow bat-like skin flaps that you use to glide. When you fall at least 10 feet and aren't Incapacitated, you can subtract up to 100 feet from your fall when you calculate fall damage. If you fall at least 10 feet, you can move horizontally 2 feet for every 1 foot you fall.

optionalfeature.name: Wondrous Translator
entries: The wearer of this magical object understands any language that it hears spoken aloud as if it were its native tongue.

entries.name: Improvement
entries: At 11th level, the wearer can also speak any language it hears as if they were a native speaker.

optionalfeature.name: Wondrous Whip
entries: The wielder of this magical object can use it to cast the {@spell thorn whip} Cantrip using the object as the material component of the spell, and your Intelligence as the spellcasting ability.

The wielder can choose for the spell to do 0 damage. If it does, it can pull a target smaller than it up to 30 feet closer, and can catch objects in a fre hand. If the target is larger than it, the wielder can pull itself up to 30 feet closer to the target.

entries.name: Improvement
entries: At 11th level, this weapon gains a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls. This bonus increases to +2 at 17th level.

optionalfeature.name: Basic Replication
entries: At any point after you learn this Infusion, you can spend 1 hour examining a Common magic item with Tinker's Tools. Knowledge of that item replaces this Infusion, and you can infuse an object with the properties of this magic item.

entries.name: Repeatable
entries: You can learn this Infusion multiple times, but you must use each instance on a different magic item.

optionalfeature.name: Greater Replication
entries: After you learn this Infusion, you can spend 1 hour examining an Uncommon magic item with Tinker's Tools. Knowledge of that item replaces this Infusion, and you can infuse an object with the properties of this magic item.

entries.name: Repeatable
entries: You can learn this Infusion multiple times, but you must use each instance on a different magic item.

optionalfeature.name: Advanced Replication
entries: At any point after you learn this Infusion, you can spend 8 hours examining one Rare magic item with Tinker's Tools. Knowledge of that item replaces this Infusion, and you can infuse an object with the properties of this magic item.

entries.name: Repeatable
entries: You can learn this Infusion multiple times, but you must use each instance on a different magic item.

optionalfeature.name: Masterwork Replication

item: a Very Rare magic item, various

entries: At any point after you learn this Infusion, you can spend 24 hours examining a Very Rare magic item with Tinker's Tools. Knowledge of that item replaces this Infusion, and you can infuse an object with the properties of this magic item.

entries.name: Repeatable
entries: You can learn this Infusion multiple times, but you must use each instance on a different magic item.

optionalfeature.name: Seeking Spyglass
entries: This magical spyglass is bonded to a ranged weapon. The wielder of this now-magical weapon can point it at a creature it can see within the weapon's normal range and expend one Charge to Mark the target. This Mark lasts for 1 hour, and it requires concentration. It grants the wielder these benefits:

items: When attacking the Mark with this weapon, they can use their Intelligence for their attack and damage rolls.
They always know the distance and direction of the Mark.
They add your Intelligence modifier (minimum of +1) to any Perception or Survival checks to track the Mark.

optionalfeature.name: Arcane Harpoon

item: a spear or javelin and 30 ft. of rope or chain

entries: In place of an attack, a creature can fire this magic weapon, making a ranged spell attack against a target within 30 feet. On hit, it takes 1d12 Piercing damage and is impaled by the Harpoon. While impaled, it is Grappled by the Harpoon and can't move beyond the 30-foot rope.

As a bonus action, the wielder can retract the Harpoon. If no target is impaled, it reloads the weapon. If an impaled target is larger than the wielder, the wielder pulls themselves up to 30 feet toward it. If the target is the wielder's size (or smaller), it is pulled up to 30 feet toward the wielder.
As an action, a creature can make a Strength check against your Spell save DC, removing the Harpoon on a success.

optionalfeature.name: Explosive Restraints

item: manacles or 50 ft. of chain (requires attunement)

entries: This magical restraint is transfigured into a bracelet. When the attuned creature hits a creature with a melee attack, it can use its bonus action on that turn to activate this magical restraint, forcing its target to make a Dexterity saving throw.

On a failure, it takes 2d6 Fire damage and is Restrained by the magical restraint for 1 minute. On a success, it takes 1d6 Fire damage. The Restrained creature can use its action to make a Strength saving throw, escaping on a success.
As an action, the attuned creature can recall the restraints back to its bracelet form, freeing any Restrained creature.
